metadata.title: Architectural Group Portrait with Geometric Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a group portrait within a curved glass atrium on the left, mirrored by a minimalist wireframe architectural diagram on the right.
triggerTerms: split screen photography and line art
excludeWhen: organic or rustic themes are requested
vibrant or neon color palettes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated composition that balances a realistic photograph of a group in a modern, curved glass building with a clean, white-space-heavy graphic section containing a schematic wireframe of the same architecture.
coreVisualRelationships: The curve of the glass atrium on the left is echoed by the vector lines on the right.
The dark clothing of the subjects contrasts sharply against the bright, reflective floor and white graphic space.
Large-scale display typography at the top anchors the vertical split of the composition.
coreInvariants: Vertical split between photographic and graphic zones
Neutral, desaturated color palette with high-key lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six men stands in the lower-left quadrant, scaled to show full bodies against the massive scale of the atrium.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, cropped display text at the top edge acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large text at the top, down through the group of figures, then across to the minimalist wireframe on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of white space on the right side to provide breathing room and emphasize the schematic lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light grey (background and graphic zone)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and black (subject clothing and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm beige and muted brown (architectural pillars and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value/brightness in the environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Top display text is heavily cropped by the top edge of the frame

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaid on both photo and graphic zones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric uppercase for impact paired with smaller, clean lowercase for detail.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, geometric feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, modern neutrality required for the layout.
Offers the geometric precision seen in the architectural theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a group of men in dark suits standing in a modern glass atrium with curved walls and a reflective floor. The right half of the image should be a clean white space containing a light grey vector wireframe that continues the architectural lines of the atrium.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold sans-serif uppercase text at the very top, cropped so the top of the letters are cut off. Add a smaller, lowercase sans-serif subtitle aligned to the right in the white space.

verificationChecks: Is the top text cropped by the frame edge?
Does the wireframe align with the photographic perspective?
Is the color palette restricted to neutrals and muted browns?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific neutral color of the display text
Degree of cropping on the top text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical split is distinct but harmonious.
Check that the floor reflections are realistic.
Verify that the wireframe lines are thin and precise.
Confirm the typography does not use serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Modern Interior Photography] with [Minimalist Wireframe Graphic] using a [Vertical Split Composition] and [Cropped Sans-Serif Typography].
